survey.problem: I have been in the same role for two years and feel like I'm executing someone else's vision. I want to build something of my own but keep waiting for the "right time."
survey.future: In two years I want to be running a small product I built myself, earning enough to have real options.
survey.blocker: Honestly, I think I'm afraid of what it means about me if I try and it doesn't work.
survey.routine: Wake up at 7, commute, work 9–6, doom-scroll evenings, sleep late.

habits.name: One deep work block
habits.action: Work on one meaningful task with phone away for 30 minutes
habits.min: Just open the task and read it for 2 minutes

habits.name: End-of-day capture
habits.action: Write 3 things accomplished + top task for tomorrow
habits.min: Just write the one top task for tomorrow

habits.name: Evening reflection
habits.action: Write 2 sentences — what worked today, what didn't
habits.min: Just write one word describing how today felt
